_note: v2.8 31 M17 (v2.8 11 J8 create checks) live: group chat, main reply on the pod, curator + lore-creation route on DeepSeek (cloud). Guards first (measured, unestablished, hidden: none of them touches the positive), then the positive: a real lore pass over facts from real reads proposes a card that waits, the author accepts it, it is written at the next boundary and its content reaches the next prompt (activation proof); a run whose real pass proposes nothing is recorded P1 BLOCKED. Guards on the live host: unmeasured route refused with createRequireMeasured on (no call), unestablished name and hidden (gated / excluded) titles refused at plan time, auto mode never creates (a card stays pending across a boundary), createCap 2 skips the pass with no call, a card edited into the excluded title is refused at the write edge. Guard inputs are scripted lore replies (debugResponse) because a real model cannot be made to propose a refused card; the positive is never scripted.

steps.eval: const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); const name = 'SO-LIVE-V28-11 Lore'; if (!wi.world_names?.includes(name)) return { book: 'absent' }; const data = await wi.loadWorldInfo(name); const keep = ['The Harbour', 'The Ferryman', 'Sealed Vault']; const removed = []; for (const [uid, entry] of Object.entries(data?.entries ?? {})) if (!keep.includes(entry.comment)) { removed.push(entry.comment); delete data.entries[uid]; } if (removed.length) await wi.saveWorldInfo(name, data, true); return { removed };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); rt.setStagecraftSettings({ curatorEnabled: true, acceptMode: 'review', createEnabled: true, createRequireMeasured: false }); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !rt.getSnapshot().requirements?.ready; i += 1) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); const snap = rt.getSnapshot(); if (!snap.requirements?.ready) throw new Error('requirements not ready: ' + JSON.stringify(snap.requirements)); return { settings: rt.getStagecraftState().settings, scope: snap.stagecraftScope ?? null };

send_generate.text: We reach the harbour. Oskar the boatwright is patching the hull of a fishing boat on the slipway.
Oskar looks up and says he charges one silver to mend a hull. Beside him, Tilda the net-maker is mending nets.
Tilda tells us she sells her nets to every fisherman on the pier, and asks whether we need a boat.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const texts = () => rt.getExtractionFacts().map((f) => String(f.text ?? f)); const count = (name) => texts().filter((t) => t.includes(name)).length; const before = { Oskar: count('Oskar'), Tilda: count('Tilda'), facts: texts().length }; globalThis.__m17.factsReal = before; if (before.Oskar < 2 || before.Tilda < 2) { const q = String.fromCharCode(34); const fact = (t, e) => 'FACT importance=2 text=' + q + t + q + ' evidence=' + q + e + q; const read = [fact('Oskar the boatwright patches hulls at the harbour.', 'Oskar the boatwright is patching the hull'), fact('Oskar charges one silver to mend a hull.', 'he charges one silver to mend a hull'), fact('Tilda the net-maker mends nets on the pier.', 'Tilda the net-maker is mending nets'), fact('Tilda sells her nets to every fisherman on the pier.', 'she sells her nets to every fisherman on the pier')].join(String.fromCharCode(10)); await rt.runExtractionNow(read, 'm17-seed'); globalThis.__m17.notes.push('real reads left Oskar in ' + before.Oskar + ', Tilda in ' + before.Tilda + ' of ' + before.facts + ' facts-tier rows; a scripted read added four facts so the create pass is eligible (positive still a real lore call)'); } const after = { Oskar: count('Oskar'), Tilda: count('Tilda'), facts: texts().length }; if (after.Oskar < 2) throw new Error('facts tier still names Oskar fewer than twice: ' + JSON.stringify({ before, after, texts: texts().slice(-8) })); return { real: before, after };
